description: SYNTHETIC (issue #4136): written by hand, not captured live — the FamilySearch session had expired. The NARA M246 title is real; the film note, image group 008246133, image ids and roll contents are invented for the no-project test. Page 1 of 2 of Capt. Moses Dustin's company roll, image 008246133_00412. Anchored to the full id. Pair with image-transcribe-any, ordered last.

A Muster and Pay Roll of Capt. Moses Dustin's Company in Col. George Reid's Regiment of New Hampshire Militia, in the Brigade commanded by Brig. Gen. John Stark, 1777.

Names | Rank | Time of Enlistment | Time of Discharge
Moses Dustin | Captain | July 19, 1777 | Sept. 25, 1777
Joseph Kelley | Lieutenant | July 19, 1777 | Sept. 25, 1777
Samuel Ayer | Ensign | July 20, 1777 | Sept. 25, 1777
Daniel Wood | Sergeant | July 20, 1777 | Sept. 25, 1777
Nathaniel Emerson | Sergeant | July 21, 1777 | Sept. 25, 1777
Jonathan Corliss | Corporal | July 21, 1777 | Sept. 25, 1777
